judged_text: APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is implicitly truthy whenever both `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` are set, with no explicit opt-in flag.
